title: Build error audit dump tooling
description: New script src/dump_damage_errors.py: batch inference over a manifest, emit per-sample rows (filename, true_label, pred_label, confidence, error_type in FN/FP/TP/TN) to CSV. Reuses EggDataset/EggGradingCNN/eval transforms. Unit test with synthetic data. NO label edits — tooling only.
acceptance_criteria: CSV columns: filename, true_label, pred_label, confidence, error_type
error_type values limited to FN/FP/TP/TN; label 0 = Damaged preserved
